_instructions: 1. Copy this configuration to your project's .cursor/mcp.json file
2. Update the 'cwd' path below to match your project location
3. Ensure the MCP Crypto Server is installed (run ./install.sh)
5. The crypto-tools server will be available in AI conversations
- Ensure your .env file is properly configured with database credentials
- The server runs locally and doesn't send data to external services
- Keep API keys secure in your .env file
